sources.entry: BookShelves - Ebook reader and library manager with public-domain books and sync. ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/app/bookshelves-ebook-reader/id6756848973?platform=mac)

summary.name: BookShelves
summary.one_liner: BookShelves is an ebook reader and library manager for macOS and iOS that reads many ebook formats, syncs via iCloud, and offers free public-domain classics.
use_cases: Reading EPUB and other ebook formats on a Mac and iPhone
Keeping an ebook library in sync across Apple devices
Sending books to a Kindle or PocketBook by email
Browsing external libraries through OPDS catalogs
summary.what_it_does: BookShelves opens a wide range of ebook formats, including EPUB, PDF, FB2, MOBI, AZW3, CBZ and Markdown, with native rendering. It syncs the library through the user's personal iCloud account across iPhone, iPad and Mac. It can browse free classics from Standard Ebooks and the Internet Archive, and connect to any OPDS catalog. It also fetches book metadata and covers automatically, lets users edit fields, and can email books to Kindle or PocketBook devices.
notable: Free to try with a one-time Pro upgrade that works across Mac, iPhone and iPad
Built-in Calibre wireless sync server for transfers to KOReader and other devices
No account required; data stays on devices and personal iCloud
Right-to-left and vertical CJK text support
caveats: iCloud sync requires the Pro upgrade
Anonymous analytics and crash reports are collected by default, with opt-out in Settings
